status: policy-and-requirements-baseline-only; physical safeguards and travel compliance not verified

protection_domains.cybersecurity: local-first privacy, least privilege, authenticated owner access, secure updates, data minimisation, tamper and replay resistance
protection_domains.water_environment: rain, splash, dust, humidity, condensation and corrosion are future test cases; no ingress rating established
protection_domains.fire_heat_power: removable lithium battery design, Wh marking, BMS, fuse, short-circuit/over-current protection, thermal monitoring, terminal protection and safe isolation
protection_domains.communications: network and positioning loss, sensor disconnection, stale or replayed commands, clock faults and safe local behaviour
protection_domains.ai_data: false/missed object detections, uncertain spatial estimates, sensor conflicts, out-of-distribution scenes, privacy and evidence provenance
protection_domains.mechanical: four-wheel load and bearing faults, handle lock/fatigue, shell impact, tip-over/load shift, pinch zones, future drive/motor faults, emergency stop and manual handling
protection_domains.human_mission: owner control, luggage handling, mode confusion, airport/aircraft restrictions, bystander safety, airline-specific carriage decisions and privacy

project_specific_hazards: airline cabin baggage rejection due to dimensions, weight or carrier-specific smart-baggage policy
removable lithium battery restriction, damage, short circuit, overheating or unsafe handling
unexpected powered movement caused by mode confusion, reboot or power restoration
telescopic handle lock failure, excessive pull load or fatigue
wheel failure, jam, instability, tipping or shifting luggage payload
collision, pinch or entanglement during future supervised Robot Mode
camera, microphone, location or trip-data privacy exposure
sensor, localisation, communication or battery telemetry loss
unintended motor activation or unsafe operation onboard aircraft
poor storage restraint, enclosure damage or service-access hazard
